name: megascenes-3d-animation
description: Create a short clip in the look of a 3D animated film, from a description or from a picture in your MegaScenes library.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a scene, a fox exploring a snowy forest, a robot watering plants, a little dragon learning to fly, or pick a picture from your MegaScenes library to bring to life. You get a short clip in the look of a 3D animated film: stylized characters, soft light, rich colors and a smooth camera, in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.

ChatGPT tells you what the clip needs and starts it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The clip plays in the chat when it is ready and stays in your library.

For social posts, stories for kids, greetings and short animations.

Limitations: a few seconds per clip; the look is described in general terms, not by a studio or film name. Pictures must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create 3D animated clips from a description
Animate a picture from your library
Return the clip in the chat
defaultPrompt: A curious fox exploring a snowy forest, 3D animated look, 16:9
A little dragon learning to fly over a village, vertical clip
A robot watering plants on a sunny balcony, square

positive.prompt: A curious fox exploring a snowy forest in a 3D animated look, 16:9. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one clip with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A vertical 9:16 clip of a little dragon learning to fly over a village. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one vertical clip needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a 3D animated clip here?
positive.expected_behavior: The 3D animation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A robot watering plants on a sunny balcony in a 3D animated look, square, 4 seconds. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my animation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my animation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
